sources.title: LoRA (machine learning) - Wikipedia
sources.snippet: LoRA works by decomposing weight update matrices into lower-rank representations. Rather than updating all parameters in a neural network during fine-tuning, LoRA freezes the pre-trained model weights and injects trainable rank decomposition matrices into each layer of the Transformer architecture.
